author: Ari Koslow
title: John Brebbia re-signs with Rockies on minor league deal
desc: The Rockies re-signed John Brebbia to a minor league contract.
impact: Brebbia tested the open market before returning to the Rockies organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Soderstrom battling hip injury
desc: Tyler Soderstrom is not in the Athletics lineup on Thursday against the Tigers.
impact: Athletics manager Mark Kotsay said Soderstrom is managing his hip as he returns from injury. He is day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hunter Goodman (hand) returns to lineup Thursday
desc: Hunter Goodman is back in the Rockies lineup on Thursday against the Giants.
impact: Goodman returns from a two-game absence after injuring his wrist on Monday. He is back behind the plate and batting cleanup.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Jeffers (hand) expected to be activated Friday
desc: The Twins are expected to activate Ryan Jeffers on Friday.
impact: Jeffers rejoined the Twins on Thursday. He will return for the final series heading into the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Owen Caissie (calf) expected to miss 2-4 weeks
desc: Owen Caissie is expected to miss 2-4 weeks with a mild right calf strain.
impact: Caissie was placed on the injured list on Thursday. He'll likely be sidelined into August.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyler Fedko optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Twins optioned Kyler Fedko to Triple-A St. Paul.
impact: Fedko spent about three weeks with the Twins, going 0-for-16 with eight strikeouts in 14 games. He will return to Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Corey Seager (back) hopeful to resume baseball activities in next week
desc: Corey Seager told reporters he was told he needs 5-7 good days before resuming baseball activities.
impact: Seager is on Day 2 as of Thursday. He could resume baseball activities during the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryce Harper to participate in Home Run Derby
desc: Bryce Harper  announced that he's in Monday night's Home Run Derby.
impact: Harper will be playing in his home ball park. He has hit 20 long balls this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Grayson Rodriguez (back) expected to be activated Friday
desc: Grayson Rodriguez is expected to return for Friday's series opener against the Twins.
impact: Per Fletcher, Rodriguez flew to Minnesota early. It is not official, but the roster move is expected to be announced on Friday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Manny Machado (foot) back in lineup Thursday
desc: Manny Machado is back in the Padres lineup on Thursday against the Diamondbacks.
impact: Machado did not play on Wednesday after fouling a ball off his foot in Tuesday's game. He is back at third base and batting cleanup.

author: Nate Miller
title: Jim Jarvis enjoys a career day at the plate
desc: Jim Jarvis went 3-for-5 with a two-run homer and a double in Thursday's 10-5 win over the Pirates.
impact: Jarvis not only belted his first career MLB homer in the fourth inning of Thursday's win, but he also added a couple more base knocks and multiple slick plays at shortstop. The rookie has now gone 6-for-19 overall at the plate since he was recalled a week ago.

author: Nate Miller
title: Mike Yastrzemski belts grand slam in Thursday's win
desc: Mike Yastrzemski went 1-for-3 with a grand slam, two walks, and two runs scored in Thursday's 10-5 win over the Pirates.
impact: With the Braves only up one in the top of the ninth inning Thursday afternoon, Yastrzemski stepped to the plate with the bases juiced and pretty much finished off the Pirates with the third grand slam of his career. Yastrzemski is seeing the ball well right now. Over the Braves' last six games, the veteran outfielder has gone 6-for-17 with two homers, a double, four walks, and eight RBI.

author: Nate Miller
title: Matt Olson continues recent power surge
desc: Matt Olson went 1-for-3 with a solo homer, two walks, and two runs scored in Thursday's 10-5 win over the Pirates.
impact: Olson got the Braves going Thursday afternoon, launching his 25th homer of the season in the top of the first inning. The All-Star slugger has now hit five deep drives over his last seven games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Munetaka Murakami (hamstring) will return Friday
desc: White Sox manager Will Venable confirmed that Munetaka Murakami will return to the lineup on Friday.
impact: Murakami began a rehab assignment this week. He'll be back for the final series going into the All-Star break.

author: Nate Miller
title: Bryce Elder surrenders three homers in Thursday's outing
desc: Bryce Elder allowed four runs (three earned) on five hits and two walks while striking out three over four innings in Thursday's 10-5 win against the Pirates.
impact: Elder only gave up five hits in Thursday afternoon's start, but three of them left the yard. That's been the main issue for Elder lately, as he's surrendered multiple homers in three of his last four starts. During that span, Elder has posted an ugly 11.00 ERA with eight total long balls allowed across 18 innings. He was very good for a stretch out of the gate this season, but Elder is best left on waivers in fantasy leagues now.
